title: 🔆🔅Two Violating Oil Tankers Explode on Unauthorized Route in the Strait of Hormuz
text:
🔆🔅Two Violating Oil Tankers Explode on Unauthorized Route in the Strait of Hormuz"

"Public Relations Office of the Navy of the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC):"

"🔹 Two violating oil tankers exploded after hitting a naval mine on an unauthorized route in the Strait of Hormuz."

"🔹 One of these tankers was a supertanker, and after a severe explosion it is burning because it was transiting the Strait of Hormuz through an unauthorized route."

"🔹 These tankers had turned off their navigation and identification systems and intended to pass secretly through an unauthorized route in the Strait of Hormuz with the support of the U.S. “terrorist army.” After the incident, they were halted in place.
